title: Crypto misuse: ioctl_set_tag framework layer accepts taglen 1-11 (below FIPS minimum)
description: In src/cdev/crypto2dev_fd.c ioctl_set_tag() (~line 861): the framework validates 'if (op.taglen == 0 || op.taglen > CRYPTO2DEV_TAG_MAXLEN)' (CRYPTO2DEV_TAG_MAXLEN=16). This accepts taglen values 1..11 which are below the FIPS 140-3 SP 800-38D minimum of 96 bits (12 bytes). The wolfssl and kcapi providers correctly enforce the >=12 minimum in their set_tag() callbacks, so the operation is ultimately rejected — but the framework should enforce the FIPS bound before dispatching to the provider. A future non-compliant provider registering set_tag without the 12-byte check would silently accept sub-minimum tags. Add 'if (op.taglen < 12) return -EINVAL;' to ioctl_set_tag() before the mutex.
